query: Which object(s) bump heads with another sheep, retreat, and then charge forward to collide again?
timeBasisNote: Replay uses the saved run clock: dense frame index divided by 3 fps. The source video native frame rate was not verified.
maskStorage: one binary mask per frame; logical OR of all selected target predictions
firstFrameArtifact: The first saved mask includes an extra foreground region beside the right-hand sheep. It is retained in the complete replay.
limitations: The saved binary masks are a union; they do not retain separate per-instance colors or identities.
Predicted supports cover the clip (0.0–9.7s); they are not a precise timing estimate for each headbutt.
The first saved mask includes an extra region; no frame or mask was removed or repaired.
annotationSplit: ReVOS validation (meta_expressions_valid_.json); underlying video collection identifier retained above
sourceAttribution: ReVOS/VISA dataset by Cilin Yan et al.; underlying OVIS video. Original video copyright remains with its owners, as stated by ReVOS.

rendering.rawVideo: Source benchmark frames encoded in their original order; no frame skipped or repeated
rendering.maskedVideo: Unedited saved SAM3 union masks over source frames; no manual target box or mask supplied for this export
